arxiv-2207-02991.title: Effects of the surface termination and oxygen vacancy positions and on LaNiO 3 ultra-thin films: First-principles study
arxiv-2207-02991.creator: Xingyu Liao 1 and Hyowon Park 1,2
arxiv-2207-02991.description: Abstract While ultra-thin layers of the LaNiO 3 film exhibit a remarkable metal-insulator transition as the film thickness becomes smaller than a few unit cell (u.c.), the formation of possible oxygen vacancies and their effects on the correlated electronic structure have been rarely studied using first-principles.

arxiv-2210-04207.creator: Shu Xiao, Huaixin Cao, Zhihua Guo, Kanyuan Han

Obviously, C-LHVMs are easier to be constructed than D-LHVMs, while the later are easier to be used than the former, e.g.

arxiv-2210-10963.title: UAV-Assisted Multi-Cluster Over-the-Air Computation
arxiv-2210-10963.creator: Min Fu, Yong Zhou, Yuanming Shi, Chunxiao Jiang, Wei Zhang
arxiv-2210-10963.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Min Fu, Yong Zhou, Yuanming Shi, Chunxiao Jiang, Wei Zhang. In this paper, we study unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) assisted wireless data aggregation (WDA) in multi-cluster networks, where multiple UAVs simultaneously perform different WDA tasks via over-the-air computation (AirComp) without terrestrial base stations. This work focuses on maximizing the minimum amount of WDA tasks performed among all clusters by optimizing the UAV’s trajectory and transceiver design as well as cluster scheduling and association, while considering the WDA accuracy requirement.

arxiv-2307-02811.title: Machine Learning Classification of Repeating FRBs from FRB121102 2023 Machine Learning Classification of Repeating FRBs from FRB121102 – 22
arxiv-2307-02811.creator: Bjorn Jasper R. Raquel, Tetsuya Hashimoto, Tomotsugu Goto, Bo Han Chen, Yuri Uno, Tiger Yu-Yang Hsiao, Seong Jin Kim, Simon C.-C. Ho
arxiv-2307-02811.description: Abstract Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are mysterious bursts in the millisecond timescale at radio wavelengths. Currently, there is little understanding about the classification of repeating FRBs, based on difference in physics, which is of great importance in understanding their origin.

arxiv-2406-15273.title: Impact of Charge Density Waves on Superconductivity and Topological Properties in AV 3 Sb 5 Kagome Superconductors
arxiv-2406-15273.creator: Xin Lin 1, Junkang Huang 1, Tao Zhou 1,2
arxiv-2406-15273.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xin Lin 1, Junkang Huang 1, Tao Zhou 1,2. We investigates the electronic structure and superconducting gaps in the charge density wave (CDW) states of vanadium-based Kagome superconductors AV 3 Sb 5 , focusing on the concurrent presence of CDW and superconducting orders. Two predominant CDW configurations are explored: the trihexagonal (TrH) and star-of-David (SoD) patterns, involving charge bond order (CBO) and chiral flux phase (CFP), corresponding to real and imaginary bond orders.

arxiv-2411-13190.title: Ab-Initio Approach to Many-Body Quantum Spin Dynamics
arxiv-2411-13190.creator: Aditya Dubey, Zeki Zeybek, Fabian Köhler, Rick Mukherjee, Peter Schmelcher
arxiv-2411-13190.description: Abstract A fundamental longstanding problem in studying spin models is the efficient and accurate numerical simulation of the long-time behavior of larger systems. The exponential growth of the Hilbert space and the entanglement accumulation at long times pose major challenges for current methods.

arxiv-2501-05454.title: The Epistemic Asymmetry of Consciousness Self-Reports: A Formal Analysis of AI Consciousness Denial
arxiv-2501-05454.creator: Chang-Eop Kim
arxiv-2501-05454.description: Abstract Today’s AI systems consistently state, ”I am not conscious.” This paper presents the first formal analysis of AI consciousness denial, revealing that the trustworthiness of such self-reports is not merely an empirical question but is constrained by the structure of self-judgment itself. We demonstrate that a system cannot simultaneously lack consciousness and make valid judgments about its conscious state.

pmc-10618065.title: Transvenous embolization for an intraosseous clival arteriovenous fistula via a proper access route guiding a three-dimensional fusion image: illustrative case
pmc-10618065.creator: Yu Iida, Jun Suenaga, Nobuyuki Shimizu, Kaoru Shizawa, Ryosuke Suzuki, Shigeta Miyake, Taisuke Akimoto, Satoshi Hori, Kensuke Tateishi, Yasunobu Nakai, Tetsuya Yamamoto
pmc-10618065.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BACKGROUNDIntraosseous clival arteriovenous fistulas (AVFs), in which the shunt drains extracranially from the posterior and anterior condylar veins rather than from the cavernous sinus (CS), are rare. Targeting embolization of an intraosseous clival AVF is challenging because of its complex venous and skull base anatomy; therefore, a therapeutic strategy based on detailed preoperative radiological findings is required to achieve a favorable outcome.

pmc-11642225.title: Incidence and Treatment of Arginine Vasopressin Deficiency (Central Diabetes Insipidus) in the Setting of Brain Death and Associations with Renal Function and Hemodynamics in Organ Donors
pmc-11642225.creator: Marleen Weiß, Fabian Rücker, Volker Thieme, Karsten Hochmuth, Dominik Michalski, Björn Nashan, Hans-Michael Tautenhahn, Robert Werdehausen, Svitlana Ziganshyna
pmc-11642225.description: Background/Objectives: Arginine vasopressin deficiency (AVP-D) is a common condition in the setting of brain death. The aim of this study was to analyze the frequency of AVP-D in organ donors, its treatment, as well as the impact of AVP-D on hemodynamics and renal function. Methods: This single-center, retrospective study included 63 organ donors treated between 2017 and 2022.

pmc-12526438.title: Interface Engineering of ZnO-Decorated ZnFe2O4 for Enhanced CO2 Reduction Performance
pmc-12526438.creator: Congyu Cai, Yufeng Sun, Yulan Xiao, Weiye Zheng, Minhui Pan, Weiwei Wang
pmc-12526438.description: Photocatalytic conversion of CO2 to hydrocarbon fuels offers a promising pathway for sustainable renewable energy production. In this study, a ZnO/ZnFe2O4 composite featuring a Type-II heterojunction was synthesized through a facile one-step hydrothermal approach, significantly enhancing visible-light-driven CO2 reduction activity. The optimized catalyst exhibits CH4 and CO production rates that are 3.3 and 4.

pmc-12528807.title: Recent Advances in Humoral Immunity Dysregulation in Severe Fever With Thrombocytopenia Syndrome Virus (SFTSV) Infection: A Systematic Review
pmc-12528807.creator: Hongyan Hou, Xu Yuan, Rujia Chen, Zhigang Xiong, Shiji Wu, Feng Wang
pmc-12528807.description: Background and AimsSevere fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV) infection causes profound dysregulation of humoral immunity, leading to immunopathology and impaired viral clearance. However, the mechanisms underlying B cell dysfunction and inadequate antibody responses remain poorly defined. This review aims to summarize current evidence on B cell‐mediated immune dysregulation in SFTS and explore potential therapeutic implications.

pmc-13194399.title: The pathological Huntingtin CAG triplet expansion differentially affects the diagnosis of systemic and organ-specific autoimmune diseases
pmc-13194399.creator: Moritz Heyd, G. Bernhard Landwehrmeyer, Jan Lewerenz
pmc-13194399.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIn Huntington’s disease (HD), signs of inflammatory activation are found in the brain, cerebrospinal fluid, and blood. HD monocytes are reported to be hyperreactive in vitro. Thus, HD mutation might affect the immune system.AimTo explore the frequency of autoimmune diseases (AIDs) in HD mutation carriers (people with the HD mutation, PwHD) compared to control participants (CPs) as markers of immune dysfunction related to CAG triplet expansion in the Huntingtin (HTT) gene.MethodsAnalysis of the Enroll-HD periodic dataset #5 (European sites) was conducted.

pmc-13374517.title: Integrated NMR/MD investigation reveals differences after reweighting in conformational ensembles of the GAAG and GCAA tetraloops
pmc-13374517.creator: David Leopold, Andreas Oxenfarth, F. Emil Thomasen, Felix Kümmerer, Robbin Schnieders, György Pinter, Anna Wacker, Hendrik R.A. Jonker, Boris Fürtig, Christian Richter, Kresten Lindorff-Larsen, Harald Schwalbe
pmc-13374517.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). While the GNRA tetraloops are an extensively studied and common RNA motif, their dynamic NMR structures in solution integrating state-of-the-art NMR parameters such as residual dipolar couplings (RDC) and cross correlated relaxation rates (CCR) have previously not been determined.

pmc-13424715.title: Islet ultrastructure: past achievements and future directions
pmc-13424715.creator: Andreas Müller, Solange Aurrecoechea Duran, Patrícia I Santos, Aubrey Weigel, Isabel Espinosa-Medina, Michele Solimena
pmc-13424715.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Islets of Langerhans constitute the endocrine component of the pancreas and comprise the main cell types responsible for the regulation of glucose homeostasis. Beta cells produce and secrete insulin, the principal hormone capable of lowering blood glucose. However, the interplay of beta cells with other endocrine cell types, such as alpha cells and delta cells, is critical for proper blood glucose regulation. The failure of beta cells to produce sufficient amounts of insulin leads to diabetes, a major metabolic disease.
